subject: Edge-focused model shortlist + regression plan for BlueLattice demo
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Anne Park <anne@bluelattice.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Edge-focused model shortlist + regression plan for BlueLattice demo

Hi Anne — thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Quick recap and a recommended shortlist tailored to your latency and on-device/edge constraints, plus next steps we suggest for a short eval window.

TL;DR shortlist (tradeoffs below):
- rwd-open-3.7b-q4: best latency / cost for your 512-token median, slightly lower accuracy on long-context legal Qs
- rwd-opt-13b-4bit: stronger long-context QA and synthesis, higher cost but still under your target latency for majority of requests
- open-gptj-6b-fp16: lowest infra complexity (fits our light-edge config), but shows hallucination risk on multi-hop prompts

Why these three: you mentioned 95th-latency budget of 250ms for regional edge POI lookups and a hard fallback requirement for longer synth replies. The three above give a clear canary plan (fast/cheap, mid/quality, lightweight-fallback). See attached latency_cost_benchmarks_202611.csv for measured p50/p95 on our edge profile and the prompt set we used.

Attachments & links included: prompt sets (bluelattice_promptsets_v1.jsonl), benchmark CSV, and a short PDF with sample regression cases we flagged. Drive + GitHub links below.

Suggested next steps:
1) 2-week quick eval: we deploy rwd-open-3.7b-q4 and open-gptj-6b-fp16 to your staging edge fleet; you'll run 1k representative requests/day from your test harness.
2) Quality holdouts: run the provided promptset (folder link) plus 50 of your production queries we asked for. We'll wire a small webhook to push aggregated metrics back into your dashboard.
3) If PRs look good, run a single-day A/B with rwd-opt-13b-4bit on 5% traffic to validate synthesis quality before commit.

Can you confirm: a) you can share the 50-prod-queries export (anonymized is fine) by Monday PST, and b) whether your staging nodes are available for a small canary (we only need 2 nodes for 48 hours)?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Priyom for the regression plan and Marissa for the commercial estimates.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Anne Park <anne@bluelattice.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge-focused model shortlist + regression plan for BlueLattice demo

Monica — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions before we commit to the 2-week window: 
1) For rwd-open-3.7b-q4, whats the observed token cost (USD per 1k tokens) on the edge config vs hosted?
2) The hallucination examples in the PDF — are those from our domain (medical records) or generic failures? We’re especially worried about false positives when extracting PHI.
3) Can the webhook push only aggregated metrics (no raw text)? Our security team requires token redaction at the source.

We can deliver an anonymized sample of 50 queries by EOD Tuesday. Staging capacity: we have two spare nodes this Thursday and Friday that should be fine for a short canary.

Anne
Anne Park
Head of Product, BlueLattice Inc.
anne@bluelattice.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anne Park <anne@bluelattice.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge-focused model shortlist + regression plan for BlueLattice demo

Anne — quick answers: 
1) Token cost (edge vs hosted): on our edge pricing profile, measured marginal cost for rwd-open-3.7b-q4 is ~$0.16 per 1k input+output tokens. Hosted API (multi-tenant) would be roughly $0.09 per 1k at current volumes — the delta reflects node amortization and bandwidth. I’ve put a short cost sensitivity table in the CSV (see col 'estimated_usd_per_1k').
2) The hallucination PDF contains three failure archetypes. One (example B) was derived from a redacted medical support ticket (anonymized) that mimics PHI-like structure; the others were generic multi-hop hallucinations. We flagged the PHI-like case because BlueLattice indicated extra caution there. We do not include any raw PHI.
3) Webhook metrics: yes — we can push summarized metrics only (counts, p95 latency, redaction delta, QA pass rate). No raw prompt/response will leave your network unless you opt in. We'll wire the webhook to accept pre-redacted payloads if you prefer.

Operational note: Karthik — can your team prepare the canary deployment recipe (2-node edge config) and the lightweight instrumentation (we’ll use the dashboard trace id tag "BL-2026-1128-canary")? Marissa — prelim commercial estimate for a 2-week eval + A/B uplift?

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

Anne — quick commercial note: for the 2-week eval (rwd-open-3.7b-q4 + open-gptj-6b-fp16 canary) we can offer a trial credit that covers infra costs up to $3,000 and 10k eval requests. If you move to a 3-month committed Dedicated plan after the eval, we’ll apply that credit toward the first invoice.

On the A/B with rwd-opt-13b-4bit, preliminary uplift pricing estimate (5% of traffic for 24 hours):~ $420 (compute), plus an optional model tuning bundle ($2,250) if you want domain adaptation during the A/B.

Let me know if the credit and the 2-node Thursday/Friday slot work — if so I’ll open an internal PO and we can kick off the deployment runbook.

Thanks — Marissa
